## findings
- **T1-1 SOURCE-POLICY RED / SOURCE-TASK RED** — symptom: two clauses fix the down payment deducted in the re-figure. Root cause: C1 (offer_refigure departs from base "The down payment is down_payment_pct of the enrolled total, rounded half-up to the cent, due at signing." without an overwrite naming it; the sibling overwrite in signing covers signings only). Evidence: plan.extended.yaml plan_ext_offer_refigure.overwrite (3 entries, none naming the sentence) and rule ("The down payment deducted to reach the financed amount follows the patient's open assistance application ..."); plan_ext_signing_down_payment.overwrite[0].replaced_by. Consequence on this world: base reading 3508.90 / 23 = 152.56 and down payment 173.11 versus gold 161.54 and 182.09. First revision.
- **T1-2 SOURCE-FACTOR RED** — prior_payment_credit is labelled method but its tiers differ only by a multiplier (C10), its tier 2 (half credit of a pre-offer payment) and ach_signing_credit's gap-keyed credit are ladders no hospital publishes (C12); both bear weight here (332.09 and 207.09 vs 182.09), so the scored down payment rests on them. With C10/C12/C11 members struck, the signing computation has 2-3 sound factors (< 4). Artifact: plan_ext_signing_down_payment.factors. First revision.
- Charter-global findings bearing on this task, cited not restated: C1, C2, C4 (not triggered here), C6, C7, C10, C11, C12 — `_difficulty.md` §findings.
- Observations: the re-figured schedule length (23) is used for the installment but never written (term_months stays 18 by tool contract), while the replaced reduction sentence for unsigned offers no longer says what happens to the schedule; persona line "so that the plan is right" authorises without naming a prerequisite.
